description: Fast Google web search via SerpAPI's google_light engine. Returns organic_results, related_questions and related_searches (lighter and faster than the full Google engine; no ads, inline images or other rich elements). Paginate with start (+10 results per page: 0, 10, 20, …). Localize with location or uule (mutually exclusive), gl/hl for country/language, and lr to restrict result languages.

device.description: Device to emulate for the search: 'desktop' (default), 'tablet' or 'mobile'.

filter.description: 'Similar Results' and 'Omitted Results' filter: 1 = on (default), 0 = off (show all).

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

google_domain.description: Google domain to use, e.g. 'google.com', 'google.co.uk', 'google.de'. Default google.com.

location.description: Geographic location to originate the search from, e.g. 'Austin, Texas, United States'. Mutually exclusive with uule.

lr.description: Restrict results to one or more languages, e.g. 'lang_en' or 'lang_en|lang_fr'.

nfpr.description: Exclude auto-corrected (spelling-fix) results: 1 = exclude (use the exact query), 0 = allow (default).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

q.description: Search query / keywords (required). Supports standard Google operators (site:, intitle:, quotes, …).

safe.description: SafeSearch level: 'active' to filter explicit results, 'off' to disable.

start.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based): 0 = page 1, 10 = page 2, 20 = page 3, … (+10 per page).

uule.description: Google-encoded location string (uule); advanced alternative to location. Mutually exclusive with location.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_search
title: Search Google (SerpAPI)
